status: pads owner, 2026-11-14: bond wires recomputed with the wafer.space public answers; analytic, not measured

wire_assumptions.material: AlSi 1 % (0.8 mil, wedge); Au values for the same diameter
wire_assumptions.loop_model: two straight segments: pad -> apex (h above the die face at fraction f of the plan span) -> finger surface (H = die + attach below the die face)
wire_assumptions.length_3d: min = near-end landing with the min loop; nom = finger-centre landing, nominal loop; max = finger-centre landing, max loop; nom_near_end also given
wire_assumptions.L_nH: nom = 0.2*l*ln(4h/d) with h = 0.40 mm above the In1 plane (0.874 nH/mm for d = 20.3 um); min = same with h = 0.22 mm (run-2 F.Cu ground under the wire) on the min length; max = partial self inductance 0.2*l*(ln(4l/d)-0.75) of the max length (no return nearby). Mutual coupling to neighbours and glob-top (er about 3.5-4: no effect on L) not included
wire_assumptions.relation_to_package_channel: package-channel.json bond_mm is the generator pad-centre plan estimate (uniform 211 um pitch); bond_nH_0p83 / bond_nH_1p0 = 0.83 / 1.0 nH/mm times that (0.83 = the same over-plane formula for a 25 um wire). plan_mm.C here is the audited plan length (BOND-AUDIT.md); L_nH.nom = 0.874 nH/mm x length_3d_mm.nom
wire_assumptions.die_shift_cases: x, y in {-0.1, 0, +0.1} mm and rotation in {-1, 0, +1} deg about the die centre (27 cases); rotation is an assumption (hand placement), 1 deg = 56 um at the die corner; fingers fixed
